description: Header file defining the NarratorAnnouncement class and static methods for calculator-related announcements in a Windows app, including properties for announcement details and methods to generate specific announcements.

classes.name: NarratorAnnouncement
classes.description: Represents an automation notification announcement with properties for announcement text, activity ID, kind, and processing type.

classes.name: CalculatorAnnouncement
classes.description: Contains static methods to generate specific narrator announcements related to calculator app events.

methods.name: GetDisplayUpdatedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the display has been updated.

methods.name: GetMaxDigitsReachedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the maximum number of digits has been reached.

methods.name: GetMemoryClearedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating memory has been cleared.

methods.name: GetMemoryItemChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating a memory item has changed.

methods.name: GetMemoryItemAddedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating a memory item has been added.

methods.name: GetHistoryClearedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating history has been cleared.

methods.name: GetHistorySlotClearedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating a history slot has been cleared.

methods.name: GetCategoryNameChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the category name has changed.

methods.name: GetUpdateCurrencyRatesAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating currency rates have been updated.

methods.name: GetDisplayCopiedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating display content has been copied.

methods.name: GetOpenParenthesisCountChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the open parenthesis count has changed.

methods.name: GetNoRightParenthesisAddedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating no right parenthesis was added.

methods.name: GetGraphModeChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the graph mode has changed.

methods.name: GetGraphViewChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the graph view has changed.

methods.name: GetGraphViewBestFitChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the graph view has been set to best fit.

methods.name: GetFunctionRemovedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating a function was removed.

methods.name: GetAlwaysOnTopChangedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the always-on-top setting has changed.

methods.name: GetBitShiftRadioButtonCheckedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the bit shift radio button has been checked.

methods.name: GetSettingsPageOpenedAnnouncement
methods.description: Returns an announcement indicating the settings page has been opened.
